title: PPO net2 on net1 v4: the cloned start and the first iterations
description: Recurrent PPO for net2 (src/expliccit_env/train/ppo.py) on the frozen net1 v4 (exp-net1v4-grid-10's chosen run), starting from a clone of the fixed rule at u = 0.125: one cell, tau 3 s, exploration 0.1 (log2 of the window), K = 4 rollouts of 30 s per link, 8 links per iteration from examples/net1_broad.py's net2-train set with competition over-weighted, 10 iterations. The cloned start (iteration -1) and every fifth iteration are evaluated noise-free on the validation links' new-conditions family and paired by link with the rule itself: the start must match the rule there, and the learner's diagnostics show whether the pipeline learns. A debugging run for the pipeline, not a result.
run: S="$OUT/spec-s$SEED.json"; jq --argjson s "$SEED" '.seed = $s' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
